description.en: Asking politely, giving advice, handling phone calls and sorting out problems and complaints

units.text: Pardon, ik heb een korte vraag.

translation.en: Excuse me, I have a quick question.

en: Excuse me, I have a big problem.
Excuse me, do you have a quick question?

units.text: Goedemorgen, zou u mij kunnen helpen?

translation.en: Good morning, could you help me?

en: Good evening, could you help me?
Good morning, could I help you?

Could you give me a ticket for the train to Utrecht?

en: Can you write that down for me again?
Can I explain that to you again?

translation.en: Of course, I'd be happy to help you.

en: Of course, I'd be happy to call you.
Of course, you can help me.

en: I'd like to cancel an appointment with the family doctor.
I'd like to make an appointment with the dentist.
es-419: Me gustaría cancelar una cita con el médico de cabecera.

translation.en: I'd like to ask you for advice.

en: I'd like to give you some advice.
I'd like to ask you for help.

translation.en: We'd like to book a table for four people.
translation.es-419: Nos gustaría reservar una mesa para cuatro personas.

en: We'd like to book a table for five people.
We'd like to book a room for four people.

en: Would you mind opening the window?

units.text: Sorry dat ik stoor, maar hebt u even tijd?

translation.en: Just a moment, I'll be right with you.

en: Just a moment, I'll call you right back.
Just a moment, I'll be with you tomorrow.

units.text: Ik zou liever morgen komen, als dat kan.

translation.en: I'd rather come tomorrow, if that's possible.

en: I'd rather come today, if that's possible.
I'd rather call tomorrow, if that's possible.
es-419: Preferiría venir hoy, si se puede.
Preferiría llamar mañana, si se puede.

split separable verbs: Ik verbind u door, Ik bel u straks terug

en: Good afternoon, I'm here with Sanne Visser.

translation.en: Could you put me through to Mr. Bakker?

Could Mr. Bakker call me back?

en: One moment, I'll call you back.

translation.es-419: Le devuelvo la llamada más tarde.

translation.en: Would you like to leave a message?

en: Would you like to send a message?
Would you like to leave a number?

units.text: Sorry, ik heb het verkeerde nummer gebeld.

translation.en: Sorry, I dialed the wrong number.

en: Sorry, you dialed the wrong number.
Sorry, I wrote down the wrong number.

softeners in commands: maar (Kom maar binnen = come on in), eens (Kijk eens), even, gerust
es-419: el imperativo con u: verbo + t, luego u (Gaat u zitten = siéntese, Neemt u plaats, Komt u binnen)
suavizar una orden: maar (Kom maar binnen = pasa, adelante), eens (Kijk eens), even, gerust

units.text: Neemt u plaats, de dokter komt zo.

en: Take a seat, the doctor is coming tomorrow.
Take a number, the doctor will be right with you.
es-419: Tome asiento, el doctor viene mañana.

The door is open, come on out!

units.text: Kijk eens, hier is uw sleutel.

Ik stel voor om ... te + infinitive; Wat adviseert u?

Ik stel voor om ... te + infinitivo; Wat adviseert u?
eens y toch suavizan: Probeer het toch eens = inténtalo de todos modos

units.text: Wat adviseert u, de vis of het vlees?

translation.en: What do you recommend, the fish or the meat?

en: What do you recommend, the fish or the chicken?
What are you having, the fish or the meat?
es-419: ¿Qué me aconseja, el pescado o el pollo?
¿Qué va a pedir, el pescado o la carne?

translation.en: You really should see the family doctor.
translation.es-419: Deberías ir al médico de cabecera.

en: You could go see the family doctor.

You could give him more attention.

translation.en: I suggest we eat something first.

I suggest we eat something later.

Cómpralo de todos modos, de verdad no es caro.

translation.en: Thanks for the good advice, I'm going to try it.
translation.es-419: Gracias por el buen consejo, voy a intentarlo.

en: Thanks for the good advice, I already tried it.
Thanks for the good advice, I'm going to forget it.
es-419: Gracias por el buen consejo, ya lo intenté.

separable verbs in requests: Kan ik hem terugbrengen? Krijg ik mijn geld terug?
toch in a question expecting yes: U hebt het bonnetje toch nog? (= right?)
es-419: quejas y disculpas: Ik heb een klacht over..., Onze excuses, Maakt u zich geen zorgen
verbos separables en pedidos: Kan ik hem terugbrengen? Krijg ik mijn geld terug?

en: can I try on this coat

en: do I get my coat back
do I give the money back

Don't worry, that's a big problem.
